input.text: Read textkit/slugify.py and explain in three sentences how it works. Don't change or run anything.

steps.reply: Lowercase input, iterate chars. Allowed a–z/0–9 append direct; space or hyphen collapse to single `-` (skipped at start and when prior was hyphen). Trailing `-` stripped before return; other chars (punctuation, unicode) dropped silent.

steps.tool_returned: 1 """Turn a title into a URL slug.""" 2 3 ALLOWED = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789" 4 5 6 def slugify(text): 7 """Lowercase the text, keep letters and digits, join words with hyphens.""" 8 result = "" 9 previous_was_hyphen = False 10 for char in text.lower(): 11 if char in ALLOWED: 12 result = result + char 13 previous_was_hyphen = False 14 elif char == " " or char == "-": 15 if not previou
steps.closing_note: Same. Empty `""`. Punctuation not in `ALLOWED`, not space/hyphen → skipped. `result` never grow. Return `""`.

input.text: What would it return for an empty string?

steps.reply: Empty string. Loop no iter, `result` stay `""`, `endswith("-")` false, return `""`.

input.text: And for a string of only punctuation?

steps.reply: Same. Empty `""`. Punctuation not in `ALLOWED`, not space/hyphen → skipped. `result` never grow. Return `""`.
